title: Kecksburg crash and Eric Walker connection
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Kecksburg crash and Eric Walker connection, about 1965 at Kecksburg, Pennsylvania, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I would say Kexsburg with the Eric Walker, you know, connection I think is really fascinating.
I think Eric Walker was also supposedly present at the Cexsburg accident.
tellings.difference: Says Walker was 'supposedly' present at the crash and ties him to MJ-12.
tellings.link_reason: Both link Eric Walker to the 1965 Kecksburg crash.

as_told.title: Eric Walker at Kecksburg and MJ-12

tellings.quote: Uh, during these meetings, he would say some interesting stuff like he was present at the 1965 Kexsburg UFO crash.
tellings.difference: Says Walker made the claim himself during meetings with Steinman and Azadehdel.
tellings.link_reason: Same claim that Eric Walker was present at the 1965 Kecksburg crash.

as_told.title: Eric Walker present at the Kecksburg crash

tellings.quote: Yeah. They said a civilian was in charge of Kexsburg. I thought that was Dr. or Eric Walker maybe who is Penn State and probably Majestic 12, right?
tellings.difference: Says a civilian was in charge at Kecksburg and suggests it was Walker of Penn State and possibly Majestic 12.
tellings.link_reason: Eric Walker's link to the 1965 Kecksburg crash is the same claim as this story.

as_told.title: Civilian in charge at Kecksburg, possibly Eric Walker of Majestic 12

tellings.quote: civilian. This civilian is likely Dr. Eric Walker, alleged Majestic 12 member and president of Penn State.
tellings.difference: Makes him the civilian who oversaw the cleanup and adds that he was an alleged MJ-12 member and president of Penn State.
tellings.link_reason: Both say Eric Walker was present at the 1965 Kecksburg crash.

tellings.quote: That was later. I because he said some things. I got the interview. I said, "Phone him back. Ask him if he was at Kexsburg because he was talking about things that seem to indicate he was at Kexburg." And he said, "I was there. So what?"
tellings.difference: Adds that Walker himself confirmed it on a phone call ('I was there. So what?'), where the story only says he was supposedly present.
tellings.link_reason: Both claim Eric Walker was present at the 1965 Kecksburg crash.

as_told.title: Eric Walker admits he was at the Kecksburg crash

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says he finds the 1965 crash at Kecksburg, a small town in Pennsylvania where something is said to have come down, especially fascinating because of a man named Eric Walker. In another telling Michels says Walker was supposedly present at the crash and ties him to Majestic 12, a supposed secret group of officials said to handle UFO matters. If true, it would link the crash to that hidden group.
